Integrate difficulty choices and the complete game core

Unit 1 · Week 10 · Lesson 1 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the current Year 11 project brief, project-workbook.md, project-milestones.csv, project-test-log.csv and the selected scenario starter in project-pack.zip. Check the four S01 preparation exits first. Use the shared FR/NFR contract at https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/assessments/games/year11-requirements.md . Keep school-issued support, assessment and submission conditions visible. Use a disposable local folder, synthetic labels, primitive shapes and permitted static assets. Suggested times are untrialled; record actual completion/support and re-plan openly if needed.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

Current project workbook · Shared game requirements · Project test log · Ten workshop milestones

1. Integrate the two difficulty choices

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Milestone and learning intention

FR9 changes only patrol interval. The selected difficulty survives pause; restart resets the current run. Document whether the school-issued interface returns to menu or restarts at the selected difficulty, keeping all common reset requirements; do not invent a contradictory new rule. Integrate primitive fallbacks before cosmetic work. Keep the known-good version so subsequent repairs can be compared. No new difficulty levels or features are required. 6. Independent workshop

Suggested time: 25 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent milestone with optional scaffold

Reserve this 25-minute block for the learner’s own milestone. Support by returning to one preparation example or asking a diagnostic question; record help received.
